preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: name == '' and return_value == 'name must be at least one letter'
postconditions.description: If the input name is empty, the output must be the error message 'name must be at least one letter'.

postconditions.expression: name != '' and len(return_value) == len(return_value[0]) and all(len(row) == len(return_value[0]) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: If the input name is not empty, the output must be a perfect square matrix (nested array with the same number of arrays as the length of each array).

postconditions.expression: name != '' and all(all(char in name or char == '.' for char in row) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: If the input name is not empty, all characters in the output matrix must be from the input name or periods (`.`).
